motifs.label: Fork
motifs.evidence: f6 forks the knight on e7 and bishop on g7. Capturing the forking piece does not escape: Bxf6 permits a forced mate (Bh6+ Bg7 Bxg7#). Other defences concede a verified local material gain on the fork targets or mate; legal recaptures and immediate off-square losses are included. The mating continuation is conditional, not a forced mate from this position.
